outer_statements.name: rk_plugin_library
outer_statements.prose: every library named by plugin.library.paths, including code it invokes, registers rk_conf callbacks only through public setters and only when each callback meets that member's candidate contract; it registers interceptors only through the public setters, with success result zero and each exact list/union-arm candidate in outer-candidates:5c3f8c4723832c0e9e6ebb784be6a57ebc0264d519421d5b95a18a8f68c18147; every registered interceptor and all code it invokes meets that inventory's neutral custody restriction (all pointer arguments borrowed, no release, retention, ownership transfer or global custody effects, scalar resource handles borrowed too, and every local acquisition balanced before return); registered callback code and opaque contexts remain valid through the last possible invocation, including destruction and copied on_new registrations; configuration interceptors are installed on a live configuration and client interceptors only from on_new before initialization completes, never on share consumers; it calls cJSON_InitHooks nowhere and does not replace cJSON's global allocator hooks; it neither mutates cJSON child, prev or next links directly nor passes malformed cJSON lists to an API call; it never directly stores into librdkafka internal members (including callback fields, op fields, broker and rule-14t links, queues and list links); it invokes no non-public librdkafka symbol and calls public APIs only under their published conditions; any allocator hooks installed before this library loads satisfy cjson_allocator_hooks
